name: LiDAR-Camera Fusion
description: Sensor fusion operations: distance-based colorization, region-of-interest extraction, and multi-resolution analysis for combined LiDAR and camera processing.

videos.title: 3D LiDAR Features Extraction & Machine Learning for Cars
LiDAR 3D Point Cloud: Full ML Pipeline & Bounding Box Detection

theory.overview:
LiDAR-Camera fusion combines 3D point cloud data with 2D imagery. A 3D point $P = (X,Y,Z)$ projects to pixel $(u,v)$ via:
$$\begin{pmatrix} u \\ v \\ 1 \end{pmatrix} = \frac{1}{Z} K [R|t] \begin{pmatrix} X \\ Y \\ Z \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$$

intensity_colorization.title: Distance Colorization
intensity_colorization.content: Points colored by distance from origin using a selected colormap.

roi_extraction.title: ROI Extraction
roi_extraction.content: Extract a sub-volume defined by axis-aligned percentage bounds.

multi_resolution.title: Multi-Resolution Downsampling
multi_resolution.content: Near regions use fine voxels, far regions use coarse voxels.
